title: The Ionising Radiations Regulations 2017 (IRR17)
what: The main UK law on protecting workers and the public from ionising radiation at work.

title: Work with ionising radiation: Approved Code of Practice and guidance (L121)
what: How to comply with IRR17 in practice. Free to download.

title: The Nuclear Installations Act 1965
what: Site licensing for nuclear installations, and operators' liability for nuclear damage.

title: Safety Assessment Principles for nuclear facilities (SAPs)
what: The principles ONR inspectors use to judge a licensee's safety case.

title: The Radiation (Emergency Preparedness and Public Information) Regulations 2019 (REPPIR)
what: Planning for radiation emergencies and informing the public about them.

title: The Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016
what: Permits for radioactive substances activities, including disposal of radioactive waste.

title: Fundamental Safety Principles (SF-1)
what: The safety objective and ten principles that all IAEA safety standards build on.

title: Radiation Protection and Safety of Radiation Sources: International Basic Safety Standards (GSR Part 3)
what: The international basic safety standards for occupational, public and medical exposure.

title: ICRP Publication 103: The 2007 Recommendations of the International Commission on Radiological Protection
what: The system of radiological protection: justification, optimisation and dose limits.

title: The Ionising Radiation (Medical Exposure) Regulations 2017 (IRMER)
what: Protecting patients during medical exposures, from diagnosis to therapy and research.

title: ARSAC Notes for Guidance
publisher: Administration of Radioactive Substances Advisory Committee
what: Licensing and good practice for administering radioactive substances to people.

title: Civil Nuclear: Roadmap to 2050
what: The government's plan for new nuclear power, fuel, waste and skills up to 2050.

title: Nuclear Decommissioning Authority Strategy
what: How the NDA plans to clean up the UK's historic nuclear sites.

title: Implementing Geological Disposal: Working with Communities
what: The policy for finding a site for a geological disposal facility for higher-activity waste.

title: Towards fusion energy: the UK fusion strategy
what: The UK's plan for developing fusion energy.

title: UK Radioactive Waste and Materials Inventory
what: How much radioactive waste and material the UK has, and where it is.

title: LiveChart of Nuclides
what: An interactive chart of nuclides with half-lives, decay modes and levels.

title: NuDat 3
what: Nuclear structure and decay data, searchable by nuclide.

title: ENSDF: Evaluated Nuclear Structure Data File
what: The evaluated database of nuclear structure and decay.

title: JANIS: nuclear data display program
what: Browse and plot evaluated nuclear data libraries, such as cross sections.

title: PRIS: Power Reactor Information System
what: Every power reactor in the world: status, type and performance.

title: Stopping powers and ranges (ESTAR, PSTAR, ASTAR)
what: Stopping powers and ranges for electrons, protons and alpha particles.

title: SRIM: the stopping and range of ions in matter
what: Software for ion stopping and range calculations.
